detail.longDescription: 🐸 NEW: Most # animals make ketone bodies in the liver when # glucose runs low, and the # blood carries them to the # brain . A University of # Missouri study found that # bullfrogs also produce # ketones directly inside brain tissue, letting neural activity continue without glucose. This may explain how the # frogs restart key brain circuits each # spring after # hibernation , when # energy stores are thin. 👉 https://www. popsci.com/environment/bullfro g-brain-superpower-backup-fuel/ # metabolism # amphibians # neuroscience # biology # research # winter # physiology # science # wildlife # nature # diseases
